summary: Tested the new admin counsel-credential rotation feature end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (/api/admin/settings/counsel GET + /rotate: field contract, RBAC, validation 400s, 409 collision, readonly 403, rotate→login with new creds, old creds 401). Verified true persistence with a REAL `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`: rotated creds still logged in (200) and old env creds stayed rejected (401) — the seeder refactor works. Frontend: page renders, env-default amber warning shows, rotation via UI works with correct toast + refreshed current-state card, client-side mismatch/length validation works, and /admin/settings/counsel is correctly blocked for the counsel (readonly_admin) account (redirects to /dashboard). Regression: iter32 + iter33 counsel suites 33/33 pass. Counsel account was rotated BACK to counsel@birthright.org / counsel-review-2026 (verified login 200), so test_credentials.md remains accurate.

minor.issue: Counsel (readonly_admin) JWT returns 200, not 403 — because auth_utils.require_roles('admin') admits readonly_admin platform-wide. Intent stated was admin-only. Impact is low (counsel sees their own email) but the response also leaks `env_password_default_in_use`, telling counsel whether the account still uses the published env default. Consider an explicit role=='admin' check in this router.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Counsel credentials' QuickActionCard was added to AdminDashboard.jsx, which is now routed at /admin/stats — NOT to AdminHub.jsx which serves /admin. So the primary Admin hub has no link to /admin/settings/counsel (link count 0 on /admin, 1 on /admin/stats). Add an entry to the 'Governance & System' group in AdminHub.jsx.

issues: The 'SETTINGS · COUNSEL' label span renders inline on the same baseline as the '← Admin Hub' back-link and collides with the h1's briefcase icon (see header of screenshot) — label should be block-level below the back link.
Page content is left-flush at x=0 and the card grid only spans ~940px of a 1920px viewport — hub is not centered/constrained like other pages. Likely pre-existing, unrelated to this feature.

action_items: Add a 'Counsel credentials' → /admin/settings/counsel entry to AdminHub.jsx (Governance & System group); the tile in AdminDashboard.jsx only shows at /admin/stats.
Optional hardening: gate GET/POST /api/admin/settings/counsel on role == 'admin' explicitly so readonly_admin cannot read env_password_default_in_use.
Fix header layout on AdminCounselSettings.jsx (label span colliding with back-link/h1).
critical_code_review_comments: readonly_admin.ensure_counsel_account correctly looks up by role and never overwrites email/password_hash — verified across a real backend restart.

rotate endpoint writes db.user_token_revocations but nothing in the auth path reads it, so the 'active counsel session is invalidated on rotation' claim shown in the UI copy is not actually enforced — an existing counsel JWT keeps working until expiry. Either implement the revocation check in auth_utils or soften the UI copy.
admin_settings.rotate takes a raw `dict` payload instead of a Pydantic model — validation is hand-rolled; a small BaseModel would give consistent 422 semantics.
